pr_title: Add gesture to ViewPanner and simplify a bit its API
pr_body:
Closes [#58014](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/58014)
I guess closes [#70201](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/70201) too ? Though I am not sure trackpads trigger ScreenDrag. I am on linux and those gesture do not seem to work on my setup, no idea why.

Does the following:
- Remove the `_scroll_callback` from ViewPanner and replace it by a direct call to `_pan_callback`, as it is what it does most of the time. This required simply adding a `scroll_speed` property to ViewPanner.
- Add a `pan_axis` property to ViewPanner (mainly for `AnimationTimelineEdit`, but might be useful elsewhere IDK), to constraint panning on a given axis.
- Replace the `Vector2` argument of `_zoom_callback` by a float values, as only the Y axis was use by it anyway. The way I changed it makes it so the zoom factor is now `x + y`, which mean you can zoom with a side scroll wheel too if you have one.
- Removed the special processing in `CanvasItemEditor` that would process differently zoom value close to 1.0. I'm pretty sure it would be unused anyway.
- My mouse does not support it (not sure which device would), but I think I implemented support for high-precision zooming everywhere, as the zoom factor is now something like `1.0 + 0.1 * mb->get_factor()`. (High precision panning was already implemented.)
- Now, scrolling up zooms-in everywhere, instead of zooming out. It used to do so only in the CanvasItemEditor. 

On a side note, I got rid of the special code in `_scroll_callback` of GrapĥEdit. It seems like it did not have a huge impact, but I am not 100% sure.

I tested everything and it seems to work perfectly on PC. On my phone the zoom seems to work fine (with the pinch gesture), but panning seems a bit "slow". Maybe there's a "event units" to pixels conversion I am not aware of.
But testing on a phone small screen isn't that easy, so well, it's still better than not having support for it at all.

issue_context.title: Tileset editor does not utilise `InputEventScreenDrag`
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.alpha2.official [79077e6c1]

### System information

Mac OS

### Issue description

In 3.4.2 the tileset editor can be navigated using `InputEventScreenDrag`, however in 4.x this feature seems to be lacking, which is a shame as it's very useful.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Open 4.x editor
2. Create a tilemap
3. Add a tilemap texture
4. Zoom in
5. Try to nagivate using drag events (Mac)

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
